line.name: Joya de Nicaragua Cuatro Cinco Pata Negra
line.background_text: Cuatro Cinco Pata Negra is the most recent installment (announced for Spain in 2026) of JDN's annual Spain-exclusive Pata Negra prestige series, which each year reimagines one of JDN's core blends in an elevated, extra-aged expression limited to that market. This edition applies the Pata Negra treatment to the Cuatro Cinco (Reserva Especial) blend, originally created in 2013 as a 45th-anniversary limited edition featuring white-oak-barrel-aged tobacco.

vitolas.summary_review: Spain-exclusive annual Pata Negra release built on the Cuatro Cinco blend; medium-to-full-bodied.

research_notes: CONFIRMED distinct from Edición Europa and Secret Cask: uses a different wrapper (Nicaraguan Colorado Oscuro) and format (4.88x56 Doble Robusto). Follows JDN's established annual Pata Negra series pattern rather than being a one-off Cuatro Cinco sub-brand. Box count, exact price, and precise release date not confirmed; halfwheel's full article returned a 402 error during research, so some details rely on a secondary retailer source rather than direct critic coverage.
